title: FROM INCIDENTS TO INSIGHTS: PATTERNS OF RESPONSIBILITY FOLLOWING AI HARMS

bias_targets.target: Bias against vulnerable populations (based on protected characteristics such as race, gender, age, sexual orientation, and socioeconomic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Mixed-methods (quantitative and qualitative) analysis of real-world AI failures recorded in the AI Incident Database (AIID). The authors categorized incidents based on harmed groups—specifically labeling incidents involving 'Vulnerable individuals' harmed due to protected characteristics—and evaluated the patterns of formal acknowledgement, societal outcry, and institutional accountability that followed.
